ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between romance and friendships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between family and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between money and intimacy. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your image and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and romance. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your career and family. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The opposition between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and money. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.
